note: Curated instructional threads: the order in which standards build on one another across the four credits. Edit freely - build/validate.mjs checks that every standard id here exists, and the app derives sequencing, prerequisites and program build-out from these threads plus the framework's own numbering.

threads.label: How the system works
threads.rationale: Students cannot reason about procedure until they can place an agency, a court and a corrections system on the map.

threads.label: Ethics and professional conduct
threads.rationale: The code of ethics introduced in course 1 is the standard every later performance task is judged against.

threads.label: Communication and community
threads.rationale: Interpersonal skills, then radio and report-bearing interviews, then communication with specific populations, then the security and code-enforcement settings.

threads.label: Report writing
threads.rationale: The six interrogatives and note taking in course 2 carry into investigative reports, crash reports, security incident reports and code violations.

threads.label: Patrol operations
threads.rationale: Patrol fundamentals precede calls for service and crime prevention, and are the basis for public-service and private-security patrol.

threads.label: Authority, force and arrest
threads.rationale: Constitutional limits first, then the force continuum and arrest mechanics, then the narrower authority of a security officer.

threads.label: Criminal investigation
threads.rationale: Goals and legal limits of investigation come before information gathering, case types, and hands-on scene procedure.

threads.label: Crime scene to crime lab
threads.rationale: Scene safety gates scene processing; processing gates forensic examination; everything ends in property control and chain of custody.

threads.label: Courts and testimony
threads.rationale: Court structure and roles, then case preparation and mock trial, then testifying as a crash investigator, security officer or code officer.

threads.label: Traffic and crash investigation
threads.rationale: Traffic stops in patrol, then directing traffic, then crash scene management, causation, on-site investigation and the crash report.

threads.label: Critical incidents and life safety
threads.rationale: Response to calls and critical incidents, then first aid, emergency procedures, fire and life safety, terrorism and workplace violence.

threads.label: Private security practice
threads.rationale: Chapter 493 licensure and regulation frame every other security duty, from access control to crowd control.

threads.label: Code enforcement practice
threads.rationale: Report writing, then the administrative machinery, then the legal process and board hearing, then field safety.

threads.label: Legal office practice
threads.rationale: Legal literacy and systems, then office functions and documents, then accounting, supervision and employment.

threads.label: Technology and records
threads.rationale: Criminal justice computer applications, then legal information systems and records management.

threads.label: Career and employability
threads.rationale: Career awareness in course 1 is revisited as job-seeking, entrepreneurship and workplace performance in the capstone options.
